newsitem.title: UK: LME aluminium turns slightly firmer in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LME aluminium turns slightly firmer in late trade.

text.p: Aluminium prices edged slightly firmer in later trading on the London Metal Exchange on Thursday after closing the kerb just a dollar ahead on the day.
By 1900 GMT the light metal was indicated at $1,533/$1,535 three months, about $5 firmer than its kerb close.
Copper was a couple of dollars under the kerb level at $2,140/$2,144. However the other metals were virtually unchanged which meant zinc retained its gains of around $9 on the day at $1,056/$1,059.
